# `company.statement_watermarks`

Verified prefix of each account's statement effect storage; later commands re-prove only what follows it.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | accounts.id | Bank or card account whose statement effect storage this proof covers. |
| `code_version` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | SHA-256 of the derivation and validation code that made the proof; any change forces a full proof. |
| `through_seq` | INTEGER | yes | — | — | — | — | Last audit event sequence the proof covered; null before any sequenced event. |
| `census` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | JSON: for each append-only table, its highest row number and row count when proved. |
| `documents` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | JSON: each proved document with a fingerprint of its changeable header and current-effect pointers. |
| `accounts` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | JSON: the accounts the proved snapshot reached (the requested one and any it spans). |
| `setup` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | JSON: the ledger setup the derivation reads when proved (each account's type and currency, the home currency). |
| `digest` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | SHA-256 over the code version, census, documents, accounts, setup and schema. |
| `verified_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time of the proof. |
